name: eureka
title: Eureka
description: Find one clear idea by interview, from a blank page or from a pain, for a product, a game, a skill, a piece of content, or a service.
notes:
## Eureka

First skill of the Veebee chain (open source, MIT): from a blank page to a shipped product, one skill per step.

- Interviews the user one to three questions per turn, with lettered options and a 💡 suggestion drawn from earlier answers.
- Shows the Idea taking shape on a live page (Artifact tool) while the conversation goes on.
- Offers an optional quick competitive study (web search).
- Writes the finished Idea to `.veebee/idea.md` in the current directory, ready for the next skill, `challenge`.

Triggers: "je cherche une idée", "j'ai pas d'idée", "trouve-moi un projet", "I need an idea", "what should I build". Not for an idea the user already has and wants to refine.

No secrets, no environment variables. Source: https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/veebee-skills

changes: Question tool used only when really in the toolset; asking always ends the turn (Codex Default mode improvised answers).
A picked option plus free text refines the pick instead of replacing it.
Without the Artifact tool: chat-only interview, Idea shown in the chat at the checkpoint and the finish, browser page opened once at the finish.
Works outside Claude Code: canvas shown through the Artifact tool, or opened once from disk in the default browser and reloading itself (Codex and any runtime with a shell), or a code block.
Asks through the runtime's structured question tool when there is one (AskUserQuestion, request_user_input); the suggestion becomes the first, recommended option. Chat format kept as fallback.
Canvas declares UTF-8 and its finishing line points to .veebee/idea.md.
Grilled and retested on five evals.
Fires on blank-page phrases only; a rough idea is left to challenge.
Two new kinds, content and service, with their slots.
idea.md opens with a YAML front-matter: kind, title, lang.
Stop word and a ten-turn checkpoint.
One-sentence orientation on the first turn.
Existing idea.md: fresh directory or overwrite, nothing written before the answer.
The first turn opens with what the skill does before the first question.
The canvas shows the Idea in short headed sections at the end and asks whether the page says it right.
Autre only when the listed options are closed choices; never a workflow choice in the options.
Blank-sheet canvas with the idea in prose.
Questions numbered with lettered, vivid options and a 💡 suggestion drawn from earlier answers.
A loved reference is a taste signal, not a template.
Canvas path unique per session.
First release: finds one idea by interview, from a blank page or a pain.
